events.title: The FINAL Demo is out!
events.summary: Ahoy, crew!We've been working on the final major demo update. Here's what's included:Bounty Missions & UnlockablesAdded a new Mission system to unlock new Pirates, Structures, Items, and Events. Complete bounties to expand your roster and discover new content.Missions are available at any time from the Codex, and completed or in-progress missions are now displayed on the Game Over screen.Share Your RunAdded a Share button to the Game Over screen. Capture your results—including your captain, ship

events.title: ⚓ Ahoy! DeckWreckingPirates is setting sail for Tidal Splash! 🌊🏴‍☠️
events.summary: Ahoy crew!Come get enemy ships wrecked. See you on the high seas!The participation of the festival comes with a new demo with improved visuals! More details about it soon in a patch notes post.

events.title: Demo Patch — Massive Content Update!
events.summary: Ahoy crew,The second demo update is here! This is our biggest content update yet, adding dozens of new relics, new keywords, legendary treasures, richer events, and many quality-of-life improvements.We’ve also rebalanced pirates, improved accessibility, fixed issues with events, reduced build size by 60%, and polished the overall experience.Thanks for playing the demo and helping shape the game — your feedback has been incredibly valuable!New Content ~93 new items (97 → 130): single-turn passive

events.title: Demo Patch - Quality of Life
events.summary: Ahoy crew,Just 2 days after the demo and we have out first patch! Adding some quality of life to the game.Thanks Esty8nine, the game doctor for the invaluable feedback!Patch Notes:Balance - Simplified some units that had too many actions - Reduced coin rewards obtained by 5 per level. - Some items can't appear in Act 1 as they are too complex for beginners Controls & UI - New board controls: tap a crew member to inspect it, drag to move. events.title: DeckWrecking Pirates demo is OUT
events.summary: Ahoy crew,Demo is out, hope you enjoy it!

events.title: Playtest - Quality of Life Update Patch Notes
events.summary: Ahoy crew, Thanks for sailing with us. Here’s everything that changed:Bug FixesFixed a bug where the game sometimes wasn’t saved correctlyFixed an issue where losing Act 1 forced you to restart the Tutorial from scratchFixed a bug where the Collection wasn’t displayed properlyFixed a bug where Act 2 remained locked even after beating Act 1Abandon Run now works as expectedTutorialAdded a ! icon with Tips, always accessible during playPlayers can now retry a battle when losing in Act 1, with tips

events.title: Open Playtests Live!
events.summary: Ahoy crew, we’re so back! This past months have been huge in terms of development, and we’ve implemented a lot of improvements. So now, we’re ready to announce that our first open playtest will start as of today, April 16th.The content of the playtest is almost the same as the Demo, but the goal is to balance and polish it before going live with a Demo. Content of Playtest:4 different Acts with increasing difficulty.2 different pirate tribes (Caribbean Pirates and Holy Knights)71 different units

events.title: 💀 New Game Announcement — Soul Reaper: Endless Harvest
events.summary: Ahoy crew!We’re excited to announce our new game: Soul Reaper: Endless Harvest.We've been recently playing some incremental games and we've decided to pause DWP for 1 month to try making a quick one. We're very happy with the result, the game is fun and interesting.Now, we’re back to DeckWrecking Pirates development with full battery. Open playtests will come soon! Stay tuned.About Soul Reaper: Endless HarvestYou play as a Soul Reaper harvesting endless spirits in short, intense survival session
